name: Entity link formatter
description: Field formatter that renders an entity-reference field as a link to one of the referenced entity's link templates, with token-driven link text, route parameters and destination.

suggests.drupal/token: Enables the token browser in the formatter settings form and is the source of the [entity:*] tokens used for link text, route parameters and destination.

project_description:
Display an entity reference link using one of its templates.

 For example, add links to edit the nodes being referenced with a custom link text and a ?destination= parameter to come back to the displayed entity after the edition is finished.
